states.label: Pop next position
states.description: Pop the highest-priority retained board position. When a frame delimiter is reached, restore its ancestor and follow the delimiter's DFA transition.

states.label: Inspect board position
states.description: Read the oracle predicates and choose one visible DFA state. Delimiters are stack scope only; every tree node remains a real board position.

rules.label: this line is refuted or unexplorable
our move: scan one ordered predicate list
opponent must recover a material gain or create a stronger counterthreat

opponent replies cannot be handled by this policy

states.label: Our move
states.description: One card. Check every predicate in order, retain every matching legal move once, push one choice-frame delimiter, push all retained moves, then pop the highest-priority move. Relational moves that create or cash out a concrete material objective outrank generic checks and captures.

states.label: Exhaustive replies within budget
states.description: The complete legal reply set is small enough to enumerate. Use ordinary chess predicates only, with required_reply as the catch-all, and push every reply in one replies frame.

states.label: Replies to a banked material gain
states.description: The opponent is already down the configured material objective. Retain only a direct capture or neutralization of the gaining attacker, or a stronger forcing counterthreat such as mate, check, or a mate threat. Ordinary captures elsewhere do not undo the banked gain.

states.label: Replies to a pending target capture
states.description: Our previous move created a concrete pending capture, such as removing a sole effective defender, attacking a target with check, or skewering a valuable piece through the king. Retain only replies that move the target to safety, add an effective defender, capture or neutralize the attacker, make the intended capture cease to win the objective, or create a stronger forcing counterthreat.

states.label: Propagate proof
states.description: A choice succeeds by one proved child; a replies frame succeeds only after every retained reply has been discharged.

rules.label: a chosen move worked; discard its unused alternatives
one required reply is discharged; examine the next reply

states.label: Propagate failure
states.description: A failed choice falls through to its next candidate. One failed required reply refutes its parent choice and discards the rest of that reply frame.

rules.label: this candidate failed; try the next candidate
a required reply failed; discard the rest of its reply frame
the root position is not solved by this policy

states.label: Commit successful choice
states.description: Silently pop unused sibling positions until this choice-frame delimiter, then restore the ancestor and propagate proof.

states.label: Abort refuted reply frame
states.description: Silently pop the remaining sibling replies until this replies-frame delimiter, then restore the ancestor and propagate failure.

states.label: Solved
states.description: A root choice succeeded and every required opponent reply in its nested delimiter frames was discharged.

states.label: Failed loudly
states.description: Every candidate failed, or a required line was refuted, unexplorable, missing, or over budget.
